recentItems.title: 'Remember' Official Teaser | Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera
recentItems.description:
May mga bagay na bumabalik sa atin kapag handa na tayong makita ulit sila. 🍁❄️

Kaya may mga bumabalik sa big screens para sa isang kuwentong ipapaalala sa atin ang tunay na mahalaga. 🩵

Experience the magic of Dingdong Dantes and Marian Rivera, together once again in a new and exciting film by Mae Cruz Alviar, DGPI.

REMEMBER
An estranged couple who have forgotten what it means to love each other find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading.
 
As they remember their past, they learn that love has a long memory. All it sometimes needs is one miracle to remember.
